purpose: Demonstrate extraction-example generation and curation with frozen models. No training and no intended downstream training destination.
fixture_source: Programmatic fictional order records and deterministic document renderers authored for this experiment; no real customer data or pre-existing benchmark examples.
date_filter: All fixture instances are newly generated on or after 2026-10-24, later than both documented model knowledge cutoffs. No historical public examples are used as targets.
